decision_titles: Airport staff reorganization and position reclassification
plain_text:
PATRICK LEAHY BURLINGTON INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT  
BOARD OF AIRPORT COMMISSIONERS 
 MINUTES OF MEETING  
October 7, 2026 
Location: Large Conference Room (Room 337) 
 Patrick Leahy Burlington International Airport, Third Floor 
1200 Airport Drive, 
South Burlington, VT 05403 
[Hybrid meeting]         Approved on 11/4/26 
MEMBERS PRESENT:  Tim George, Chair  
Jeff Schulman, Vice Chair  
Robin Guillian  
    Helen Riehle  
Al Turkos 
Andrew Savage   
MEMBERS ABSENT:  Chip Mason 
BTV STAFF PRESENT:  Nicolas Longo, Director of Aviation  
Larry Lackey, Director of Planning, Engineering and Sustainability 
Dave Carman, Deputy Director – Airport Operations 
Marie Friedman, Director of Finance 
Jeffrey Bartley, Director of Innovation and Marketing 
Romeo von Hermann, Customer Experience Manager 
Jillian Waite, Office Assistant  
Alexandra Cohen, Marketing Assistant 
 
OTHERS PRESENT:   CCTV 
 
1.0 Call to Order  
1.1 Call to Order 
Commission Chair Tim George called the meeting to order at 4:07 P.M. 
1.2 Acknowledgement of Remote Commissioners 
Commissioners attending the meeting remotely identified themselves (Andrew Savage, Robin 
Guillian)
2.0 Agenda 
2.1 Approve/Adopt Agenda  
MOTION by Helen, SECOND by Al to approve the agenda as presented.  
VOTING: unanimous (6-0), motion carried.  
 
 
3.0 Public Forum 
3.1 The following members of the public made public comment, in the below order, regarding 
the respective topics: 
3.1.1  Leif Taranta – Immigration and Customs Enforcement  
3.1.2  Isaac Petersen – Immigration and Customs Enforcement 
3.1.3  Aspen Overy – Immigration and Customs Enforcement 
 
4.0 Consent agenda: 
4.1 Approval of the minutes 
MOTION by Helen, SECOND by Al, to approve the minutes as presented in the agenda 
packet, including Minutes from the September 2, 2026 meeting.   
VOTING: unanimous (6-0); motion carried. 
 
 
5.0 Executive Session: 
5.1 Approval to move to executive session 
MOTION by Al Turkos, SECOND by Helen Riehle, to move to make a specific finding that 
premature general public knowledge of the matter of Belter v. City of Burlington would 
clearly place the City and Airport at a substantial disadvantage.  
MOTION by Al, SECOND by Helen, to move to enter executive session pursuant to 1 VSA 
313(a)(1)(E)&(F) to discuss pending civil litigation to which the City and Airport are parties 
and to receive confidential attorney-client communications. 
All commissioners, Nic Longo, Larry Lackey, Dave Carman, Marie Friedman, and Jillian Waite exited 
the conference room at 4:20 pm. BTV staff members were invited to join executive session by the Airport 
Commissioners.  
        MOTION by Al, SECOND by Helen, to end executive session at 4:59 pm.  
 
6.0 Action Items 
6.1 Reorganization 
MOTION by Helen, SECOND by Al, to recommend that the proposed organizational 
adjustments for the Patrick Leahy Burlington International Airport as outlined in the memo 
and to authorize the Director of Aviation to reorganize and reclassify the affected positions 
accordingly, subject to final review and approval by the City Attorney's Office.  
DISCUSSION included: How the reorg will impact the budget this FY and next FY 
VOTING: unanimous (6-0); motion carried.  
  
 
 
7.0 Construction Update 
7.1 Construction Update, L. Lackey 
7.1.1 In addition to the written update provided to the Airport Commission, Director of 
Engineering and Sustainability Larry Lackey highlighted the following updates:
1. Able to move forward with the design for the de-icing pad recycling 
system 
2. FAA will supplement with funding 
3. Moving this exposure from 14 acres down to 3  
4. Looking at a congressionally directed spending grant to assist with jet 
bridges   
5. Also looking to apply for a grant to upgrade the children’s play area 
 
8.0 Residential Sound Insulation Updates 
8.1 Residential Sound Insulation Program Updates, L. Lackey 
8.1.1 In addition to the written update provided to the Airport Commission, Director of 
Engineering and Sustainability Larry Lackey highlighted the following updates 
1. Through OLDCC, secured funding for phase 6, working on 50 more 
homes 
2. Contractor is working on home measurements to determine materials 
needed  
9.0  Financial Update  
9.1 Financial Update 
9.1.1 In addition to the written update provided to the Airport Commission, Director of 
Finance Marie Friedman highlighted the following updates: 
1. Noticing an increase in revenue likely coming from the garage and 
Breeze landing fees  
2. Additional recent expenses include the Full Scale Exercise and cleaning 
services for the larger terminal  
3. Timing of fuel price changes causes some fluctuation in those specific 
line items  
 
 
10.0 Innovation and Marketing Quarterly Update  
10.1 Marketing Update 
10.1.1 In addition to the written update provided to the Airport Commission, Marketing 
Assistant Alexandra Cohen highlighted the following updates: 
1. Moving to negotiations with our rental car agencies  
2. Moving taxi location closer to baggage claim  
3. Just completed the second annual 5K on the airfield with 500 runners 
4. Holding a press conference on Tuesday to announce a new route 
 
 
11.0 Director’s Report 
11.1 Director’s Report, N. Longo 
11.1.1 In addition to the written presentation, Director of Aviation Nic Longo reported: 
1. Flew to Baltimore on Breeze’s new destination flight 
2. From there, drove to DC to meet with congressional delegation to ask for 
more funds   
3. Also discussed an increase to TSA pay scales  
4. We opened one side of our construction project happening inside the 
terminal
5. Hoping to open the whole thing by November, including the Observation 
Tower 
6. Full Scale Exercise is complete – lots of learning 
7. All passenger statistics continue to climb 
  
 
 
12.0 Follow Up Items 
12.1 Artificial Intelligence 
12.1.1     Policy has been established by the City. They are coming in to do a training 
with staff. We’ll provide more details after that. 
12.2 Jet Fuel Taxes 
12.2.1     We are on an agenda to present to South Burlington       
 
13.0 Adjournment 
MOTION by Al, SECOND by Helen, to adjourn the meeting.  
VOTING: unanimous (6-0); motion carried.  Meeting Adjourned at 6:02 P.M.
